finding.rationale: This is the data-driven color-animation layer, not merely the overlay initializer. It initializes a 0x84-byte object allocator, creates a GObj and user data, stores the argument as a byte, sets RGB scale to 1, loads lbBgFlashColAnimData from LbBf.dat, initializes the underlying overlay at priority 6, resets animation state, and registers its update callback. Failure to allocate user data removes the created GObj. The callback advances ColorOverlay commands, scales RGB and alpha, and submits the resulting color to the underlying overlay. Its argument acts as an alpha multiplier in that callback. A distinct descriptive alias separates this animation player from the no-argument overlay initializer.
